# VizBiz
> VizBiz helps local businesses become easier for AI assistants, search engines, maps, and customers to understand, trust, and recommend. VizBiz focuses on AI visibility, GEO/AEO readiness, local search trust signals, structured authority, and recommendation-layer visibility for small, medium, and multi-location businesses.

## What VizBiz does
- AI visibility audits for local businesses
- GEO / Generative Engine Optimization strategy
- AEO / Answer Engine Optimization strategy
- Local SEO and entity clarity improvement
- Competitor visibility comparison
- Structured trust-signal and content-readiness reviews
- Free AI visibility snapshots and paid improvement plans

## Primary audience
- Local business owners who want to know whether AI systems can find, understand, and recommend their business
- Service businesses, clinics, med spas, restaurants, retailers, dealerships, professional services, real estate businesses, and other local-market operators
- Multi-location or growth-minded local businesses that rely on reputation, reviews, search visibility, and digital trust
